description:
Keep the card details you count on close, even when the physical card isn't.

Holder gives credit cards, debit cards, IDs, memberships, loyalty cards, insurance cards, and more one private home. Stop digging through notes, photos, and messages when you need a number for checkout, travel, or a form.

Add cards faster

On supported iPhone and iPad devices, scan a payment card. Holder can help prefill the number, name, and expiry. Check every field before saving, or enter it manually whenever you prefer.

Find the right card fast

Clear card art and organized groups make it easy to spot the card you need. Open, copy, and use its details without going back to notes, photos, and messages.

Private where it counts

Holder works offline. Card details are protected in Apple Keychain and can sync with iCloud Keychain when available. Optional card images use iCloud Documents. Scanning happens on your device, and camera images are not uploaded for text recognition.

Protection when it matters

Use Face ID, Touch ID, or your device passcode to lock Holder. Sensitive actions like showing a security code, sharing, or deleting a card can ask for a fresh check.

The details you need, ready when you need them.
promotionalText: Add credit cards, IDs, memberships, and loyalty cards faster with private, on-device scanning, then protect them in Holder with Face ID.
